title: SPSU National Hackathon 2026
description: A 36-hour hackathon for student developers across the country to build innovative solutions for sustainability, healthcare, and smart infrastructure. Sponsored by IBM and Xebia, offering cash prizes and internship opportunities.

title: 15th Annual Convocation Ceremony
